alt: Artstract, collage: a blonde woman's head on a white surrealist body with a red face disc and an orange guitar shape, on mustard yellow.
description: A magazine photo of an elegant room (decanter cabinet, lamp, cake dome, handbag) is taken over by painted surrealist shapes: a white body with a red face disc, an orange guitar form, a green field and small creatures on a mustard floor, with a blonde woman's head on top. The piece sits inside the white border of a magazine page, on a hand-painted yellow-orange ground that shows on all four sides. The calmest area is the mustard floor at lower left; the scan is flat, bright and sharp.

alt: Be You, collage: a woman in pink satin hides her face behind a ringed hand, with a photographer on a rainbow flag and the letters BE YOU.
description: A large central figure in a hot-pink satin dress covers her face with a jewelled hand with black nails; at left a person in a black hat photographs the viewer from a rainbow flag, at right a woman with a dark bob in profile and a mirrored pair of pink-haired figures on a white sofa. Cut-out letters spell BE YOU on a dark interior at top right, and flowers fill the bottom left corner. It is packed edge to edge with no empty space; colour is saturated and the scan is sharp, with visible magazine print texture.

alt: Blues, collage: a woman in a black swimsuit stands behind a white sports car on dark blue sea, under a patchwork of blue paper squares.
description: A white 1980s-style sports car faces the viewer, floating on deep blue water with tiny sailboats, and a woman in a black cut-out swimsuit stands behind it with her hands behind her head. The upper half is a grid of blue, teal and white paper squares, with a second small swimsuit figure hanging from a trapeze at top left. Symmetrical and centred; the open water at the bottom is the quiet area.
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 556 px wide, only a 480 px file) and soft with compression blur; small card only, never large.

alt: Candy, collage: a face with an orange bob, its mouth replaced by a psychedelic sticker of red lips, above a pink blazer and a hand of candy.
description: A magazine-cover face with a sharp orange bob fills the frame; from the nose down it is covered by a scalloped, psychedelic sticker of an open red mouth with a patterned tongue. Below are a black choker, a pink blazer with round price stickers on the chest, and at lower right a hand with red nails holding blue and red sweets. The background is loose pink, blue and red brushstrokes; there is no empty space.
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 849 px wide, only a 480 px file); crisp enough for a card, cannot go large.

alt: Curiosity, collage: a man and two children seen from behind study an antique wall map, below a wooden wall with a sign, Radical Intimacy.
description: A man holding a small girl's hand and an older child pointing stand with their backs to us at the bottom left, looking up at a huge sepia fresco map framed by a painted arch with classical figures and cherubs at right. A panel of weathered grey wood at top left carries a burgundy rose-shaped handbag and a chalk sign; a pale pink feathered hat, two small fashion figures and a pair of yellow boots are tucked around the edges. The middle band of the map is open and calm, the light is warm and even, and the scan is sharp.

alt: Day # 25, drawing and collage: a drawn blonde woman's face with red lips on a pink crayon ground scattered with white paper stars.
description: A hand-drawn fashion-style face with long blonde hair, green eyes and dark red lips is cut out as a tall arch and pasted low in the centre. The ground is pink crayon scribbled with a few darker pink clouds and covered in cut-out white starbursts. Simple and centred, with the upper third free of anything but stars and clouds.
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 523 px wide, only a 480 px file) and soft; small card only.

alt: Female Cactus, collage: a green cactus cut from ruched fabric, with paper thorns and pink flowers, rising from sandy rock on white paper.
description: One big rounded cactus, cut from a photo of bright green ruched fabric, stands just right of centre with pale paper thorns and hot-pink flower balls, planted in torn strips of sand-coloured rock across the bottom. The words WILDLIFE SEES IT are pasted in black at top left. The ground is pure white paper with generous empty space on the left and top right; on an off-white page the white sheet will read as a rectangle. Very sharp, very high resolution.

alt: Gaga's Offering, collage: a pink-haired woman in a red horned headpiece holds an upside-down red figure, under purple glitter stars.
description: A woman with sculpted pink hair, a tall red horned headpiece and long gold claw nails stares straight out from the right of centre, hands on hips over an upside-down figure dressed in red stripes. Purple glitter starbursts fill the pale pink sky at the top; the left third is a dusk beach with a pelican, a campfire and a red sunset. Dense and high-contrast, with the darker beach at left as the only quieter area; sharp scan.
words: ESTA NOCHE FIESTA A LA PLAYA (faint, left middle)

alt: Home, collage: two young people play-fight in a field below a highway overpass, above a cut-paper garden with a small red barn.
description: A magazine photograph of two young people mid kick in a grassy field under a concrete overpass takes the top half, in soft overcast light. The bottom half is a garden built from cut-out leaves, cabbages, purple flowers and a tiny red barn, with a tall leafy cut-out tree at the right edge. The pale sky at the top is the empty space; a printed magazine caption is still visible in the top left corner.
words: a smaller printed photo-credit line under it, too soft to read reliably
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 840 px wide, only a 480 px file), soft, with a white scan margin on the left and bottom edges; card only.

alt: I Am the Bad Guy, collage: a person with long blue hair seen from behind, skateboarders, a man in a skull T-shirt and a Bad Hombres sign.
description: A figure with long electric-blue hair and a varsity jacket stands with their back to us at lower centre, next to a cluster of skateboarders on yellow flames and a man in a green skull T-shirt at right. The top band runs from underwater fish at left, through a small-town street under a Coca-Cola and Bad Hombres roadside sign, to a pale green cinder-block building with graffiti. The dark asphalt wedge at lower left is the calm area; daylight colours, very sharp and very high resolution.

alt: Let Out, collage: a red profile shouting inside a jagged burst, a black-and-white face with closed eyes, banknotes and red letters Let Out.
description: At left a black-and-white face with closed eyes sits above a red-orange profile shouting with its mouth wide open, cut into a jagged lightning-burst shape. The right side is a black-and-white photo of hundred-dollar bills with big red letters LET OUT. and IT across the top; a woman in a white tank and jeans lies across the bottom right with a white cut-out edge, and book spines run sideways at bottom left. A small paragraph of white magazine text from a bank advert (it names the bank) is legible at right when shown large. Hard contrast, very sharp, almost no empty space.
words: THE SUBTLE ART OF NOT GIVING A
a short paragraph of small bank-advert text (names Amerant)

alt: Looking, collage: a small crowd seen from behind watches a launch site with a rocket and a tall tower, under squares of sky-coloured paper.
description: A row of spectators and photographers, backs to us, lines the bottom edge and looks toward a distant runway, with a rocket shape glowing orange at left and a tall cylindrical tower on a launch stand at right. The sky between them is a patchwork of pale blue, white and beige paper rectangles with the word Look pasted in the middle and a cut-out cloud breaking the top edge. Airy and light, with torn white paper margins around the sheet.
qualityNote: Low resolution (source 819 px wide, only a 480 px file) and slightly soft; uneven white margins from the scan; card only.

alt: Lucky Pleasures, collage: a woman in a tan bra with red lips pasted over her eyes, reaching hands and a Lucky Strike pack on red-pink paint.
description: A torso in a tan bra with arms raised, cut as a tall curved strip with a torn top edge, stands left of centre with a pair of red lips pasted over the eyes; three separate arms reach in to touch it. A close-up mouth biting a finger fills the top right and a Lucky Strike cigarette pack sits at bottom right, all on a ground of swirling red and hot-pink paint. Sharp, hot and saturated; note the lingerie and the tobacco brand before placing it somewhere prominent.
words: C:C (signature, top left, faint red on red)
